title: Effect of Ashwagandha (Withania Somnifera) Root Powder Supplementation on the VO2 max. And Hemoglobin in Hockey Players
abstract: Randomized parallel placebo-controlled trial in male hockey players assessing maximal oxygen consumption with the Cooper run test after eight weeks of supplementation.

title: Effect of Withania somnifera on physical and cardiovascular performance induced by physical stress in healthy human volunteers
abstract: Randomized placebo-controlled parallel pilot trial in healthy volunteers comparing two doses of Withania somnifera for 28 days, including oxygen consumption assessed by YMCA submaximal exercise testing.
